question:
(i) What is meant by quantisation of electric charge?
(ii) A body has charge $-6.4 \times 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$. Find the number of excess electrons on it. Take $e = 1.6 \times 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$.

options.A:
(i) Charge exists only as an integral multiple of $e$, i.e. $q=ne$
(ii) The body has $4$ excess electrons
options.B:
(i) Charge can exist in any fractional multiple of $e$
(ii) The body has $2$ excess electrons
options.C:
(i) Charge is independent of elementary charge
(ii) The body has $6$ excess electrons
options.D:
(i) Charge is always continuous
(ii) The body has $4$ deficient electrons
